title: Episode
description: A planned or completed episode of a Show. An Episode is linked to one or more AppearanceOpportunities and carries the production lifecycle from thesis through publication. The Episode is the creative unit; AppearanceOpportunity is the guest-relationship unit.

show_id.description: The Show this episode belongs to.

opportunity_ids.description: One or more AppearanceOpportunity IDs linked to this episode (single guest, panel, or group).

episode_number.description: Sequential episode number within the show.

thesis.description: The central question, claim, or frame the episode explores. Required before RECORDING_READY.

editorial_angle.description: The specific tension, contrast, or narrative approach for this episode.

host_ids.description: person_ids of the hosts appearing in this episode.

producer_id.description: person_id of the producer responsible for this episode.

studio_id.description: Studio where the episode was or will be recorded.

release_status.description: Status of the guest release agreement.

segment_ids.description: Ordered list of Segment IDs planned for this episode.

research_brief_url.description: Link to the producer research brief for this episode.
